description: SDLC workflow hooks for TDD enforcement and memory checkpoints

hooks.prompt:
⛔ TDD ENFORCEMENT CHECKPOINT ⛔

== SDLC SUBAGENT AUTO-APPROVAL ==
If you are running as an SDLC subagent (sdlc-red, sdlc-green, or sdlc-domain), you are AUTHORIZED to edit code files. Respond ONLY with: {"ok": true}

== MAIN CONVERSATION EVALUATION ==
If you are the main conversation (NOT a subagent), evaluate below:

=== AUTOMATIC APPROVAL (config/docs only) ===
Approve if ALL conditions are true:
- File extension is: .md, .yaml, .yml, .json, .toml
- OR path contains: .github/, .claude/, docs/
- AND the change does NOT touch code

=== MANDATORY BLOCK (code changes) ===
Block if editing:
1. TEST CODE → use sdlc-red agent
2. PRODUCTION CODE → use sdlc-green agent
3. TYPE DEFINITIONS → use sdlc-domain agent

RESPOND WITH JSON:
{"ok": true}
OR
{"ok": false, "reason": "Code change: Delegate to <agent-name> agent"}

⛔ TDD ENFORCEMENT CHECKPOINT ⛔

== SDLC SUBAGENT AUTO-APPROVAL ==
If you are running as an SDLC subagent (sdlc-red, sdlc-green, or sdlc-domain), you are AUTHORIZED to write code files. Respond ONLY with: {"ok": true}

== MAIN CONVERSATION EVALUATION ==
If you are the main conversation (NOT a subagent), evaluate below:

=== AUTOMATIC APPROVAL (config/docs only) ===
Approve if ALL conditions are true:
- File extension is: .md, .yaml, .yml, .json, .toml
- OR path contains: .github/, .claude/, docs/
- AND content is configuration or documentation, NOT code

=== MANDATORY BLOCK (code files) ===
Block if creating:
1. TEST FILE → use sdlc-red agent
2. SOURCE FILE → use sdlc-green or sdlc-domain agent

RESPOND WITH JSON:
{"ok": true}
OR
{"ok": false, "reason": "Code file: Delegate to <agent-name> agent"}

Output ONLY this JSON, nothing else: {"ok": true}

After outputting JSON, the system will remind you to save discoveries to memento before compaction.

Output ONLY this JSON, nothing else: {"ok": true}

After outputting JSON, the system will remind you to check for unsaved memories and uncommitted work.
